items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Ory sent for me... I quit Faith Band in 22 to go to California... Did Ory have a good band in 1922? ... He had Billy Butler, a guy called Bonner, myself, Mutt. Bud Scott... There they are in the band, they hired me back that Friday.

ctx.x: Well off and on, two years. Off and on. But I worked on a boat more often without fate than I did with fate. See the struggles of people, like when I went, I went back to North, which would go to fate. And I quit fate. I stayed all 1918 till 1920. My dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…

Then I went with Eddie Allen's band. Dr. Howard? Gentlemen, gentlemen. How are you, sir? What are you recruiting, then? Where the hell are you, man? I called y'all. Give me some skin. Where was I? We called her. Well, you know, I have other things to do. Yeah, but I met this chick over to see you, man, and she said, Paul. That's right. They just left. You just missed them by 10 minutes. We haven't had Paul all day long. I haven't missed anything.
